::: {#exr-linearity-use}

#### Why the average of a sample is a random variable

Let $\dsn{X}$ be independent draws from the same distribution,
each with mean $\mean$ and variance $\varpar$,
and let $\bar X = \avgin X_i$ be their average.

Use @thm-linearity-expectation to show that $\Ep[\bar X] = \mean$,
and say in one sentence what that does *not* tell us.

:::
